feeds.title: Les Ailes Du Canal Blog
feeds.description: Get all the news of the Ailes du Canal in Paris: Courses, Advice, etc. Located in Paris , more precisely at the Métro République, 'Les Ailes du Canal' is your best ally if you want to have iron health. Whether it's fitness, muscle building , or just plain stress relief , our gym welcomes you with open arms. We have all the necessary elements to receive our students and newcomers in good conditions.

feeds.title: Cercles de la Forme Blog
feeds.description: Follow the advice of our coaches with the sports coaching section of the blog Les Cercles de la Forme! Bodybuilding, fitness, martial arts: discover exercises and ideas to progress with confidence. At Cercles de la Forme, we guide you towards the success of your goals, whatever they may be. This success, it is with dedicated support, à la carte, according to your needs, that you will achieve it.

feeds.title: TF Formation Blog
feeds.description: Get more information on fitness, health, exercise regime, trainer courses and more! The training courses organized by TF Formation (Pilates, Yoga, Port de Bras, Freestyle, etc.) all have a common denominator: passion. First, the one who drives our trainers, all recognized for their technical skills and their pedagogy; but also the passion that they manage to transmit to the participants thanks to a method based on listening, sharing and perseverance.

feeds.title: CT Fitness Blog
feeds.description: CT-Fitness is more than a website, it's a community of support, education and encouragement. We want to democratize CrossFit through this blog, and bring you advice and ideas to better practice your favorite sport. We believe that CrossFit and military training are closely related. We help you achieve your goals by integrating a variety of exercises and functional movements.

feeds.title: Fitness Tech Blog
feeds.description: Explore our blog for equipment reviews, news on the latest technology, fitness tips, healthy lifestyle and more! Our fitness store stands out for its wide range of products to perform bodybuilding and aerobic exercises, including treadmills, ellipticals and spinning bikes to enjoy a good cycling session.

feeds.title: Polar Blog » Workout
feeds.description: Explore athlete stories and pro tips for runners, triathletes and fitness enthusiasts. We offer a comprehensive range of products suitable for all levels of fitness, along with the essential associated support and advice, whether enhancing an athlete's athletic performance or helping a person to adopt a healthier lifestyle, undergo rehabilitation or manage their weight.

feeds.title: Oui In France » Healthy Living
feeds.description: Explore my articles on healthy lifestyle, tips for health and fitness and more! I'm Diane, the creator of Oui In France. Originally from the fine state of New Jersey, I now live in the Loire Valley with my French husband, Tom. Oui In France launched in May 2012 and is a living abroad lifestyle blog and YouTube channel.

feeds.title: MAXPRO Fitness Blog
feeds.description: Explore our blog and news on health, fitness, lifestyle, exercise and more! Meet MAXPRO - the Most Versatile and Portable Smart Home Fitness Machine as seen in Shape, Men's Health & Runners World. Cable Resistance from 5-300lbs in smart & compact machine. Connect your SmartConnect via Bluetooth to the MAXPRO Coaching App to learn new workouts, track progress and get real time feedback!

feeds.title: Kettler Sport » Fitness Guide
feeds.description: Browse through our fitness guides for exercise tips and advice, health advice, healthy food tips and more! Since its beginnings in 1949, KETTLER Sport has stood for quality and innovation. Over the past decades, the company has actively marked the home sports market and has continuously set new standards.

feeds.title: Vita Liberté Blog
feeds.description: Explore our blog for articles on health, sports. fitness and healthy lifestyle. Vita Liberté combines sports and freedom by providing rooms and equipments for exercising.

feeds.title: Crossfit Louvre Blog
feeds.description: Discover in our BLOG CrossFit Louvre articles on the life of our community, but also interviews on the life of the members and what CrossFit has brought them in their daily lives. CrossFit practiced in an affiliated gym, in a group and with a qualified Coach is for everyone. At CrossFit Louvre, we welcome you whether you are looking for better health, an escape from everyday life, weight loss or performance.

feeds.title: Le Blog du Sport » Gym, Fitness, Muscu
feeds.description: Explore articles on fitness, health advice, gym, lifetsyle and more! Football, Baskeball, Handball, but also Twirling, Skating, Kin Ball: all sports are reviewed on Le Blog du Sport.

feeds.title: BODi » Fitness
feeds.description: Explore Fitness content featuring tips and workout recommendations. BODi is here to provide you with healthy eating advice, fitness tips, recipes, and more so you can achieve the results you want. Beachbody is the leading provider of fitness, nutrition, and weight-loss programs that deliver results. Since 1998, they've empowered over 20 million people.

feeds.title: Gigafit Blog
feeds.description: Discover bodybuilding and fitness training programs, nutritional advice and all the sports news on the GiGAFIT blog. Gigafit is a network of premium sports clubs in France and abroad. We want to offer our members a real social club experience while training, relaxing but also living real moments of conviviality thanks to our events.

feeds.title: Fitness Nations Blog
feeds.description: Fitness Nations is an association that lives through its site and its community on the networks, its aim is to share knowledge and good practice in strength sports. Thanks to its collaborations, Fitness Nations is a community media. Our team federates on a daily basis and animates the actors of strength sports through content with high added value.
